crossRefs.note: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
So also it is written, “The first man, Adam, became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

translations.web: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
translations.bsb: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
translations.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
translations.asv: If we live by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us also walk.
